niche_small_business_test_cases.description: A 3-vet practice struggling with appointment scheduling, reminder calls, and client communication
niche_small_business_test_cases.specific_scenario: Appointment no-shows cost $180 per slot, manual reminder calls take 2 hours daily, paper records cause delays

test_inputs.business_priorities: Reduce no-shows, eliminate manual reminder calls, digitize patient records
test_inputs.most_urgent: Reducing appointment no-shows - we lose $3,600 per month from empty slots
test_inputs.repetitive_tasks: Making 40-60 reminder calls daily, manually checking insurance eligibility, updating paper charts after each visit
test_inputs.task_frequency: 60 reminder calls per day at 2 minutes each = 2 hours. Insurance checks: 25 per day at 3 minutes = 75 minutes
test_inputs.bottlenecks: Phone tag with clients for confirmations, waiting for insurance pre-approvals, finding paper records during emergencies
test_inputs.bottleneck_impact: 15% no-show rate, delayed treatments while searching files, frustrated clients waiting for callbacks
test_inputs.automation_experience: Tried online scheduling but clients still prefer calling
test_inputs.automation_results: Scheduling software helped but most clients (70%) still call instead of booking online

niche_small_business_test_cases.description: Korean fusion food truck with high food waste and manual inventory tracking causing profit loss
niche_small_business_test_cases.specific_scenario: 20% food waste, manual inventory counts, no sales forecasting, cash flow issues from over-ordering

test_inputs.business_priorities: Reduce food waste, predict daily demand, automate inventory ordering
test_inputs.most_urgent: Food waste is killing our margins - throwing away $800-1200 worth of ingredients monthly
test_inputs.repetitive_tasks: Daily inventory counts, manual calculation of prep quantities, tracking sales by item on paper
test_inputs.task_frequency: Inventory count: 45 minutes daily. Prep calculations: 30 minutes. Sales tracking: 20 minutes end of day
test_inputs.bottlenecks: Guessing how much to prep, running out of popular items early, over-ordering perishables
test_inputs.bottleneck_impact: Lost sales when popular items sell out, $1000+ monthly waste, stressed staff during rush
test_inputs.automation_experience: Use Square for payments but track everything else manually
test_inputs.automation_results: Square helps with payments but we have no visibility into what's selling when

expected_ai_opportunities: Sales forecasting based on weather/events/historical data

niche_small_business_test_cases.description: HVAC repair company with inefficient technician dispatching and manual scheduling causing customer dissatisfaction
niche_small_business_test_cases.specific_scenario: Technicians drive 2+ hours between jobs, emergency calls disrupt schedules, customers wait all day for service windows

test_inputs.business_priorities: Optimize technician routes, reduce emergency response time, improve customer communication
test_inputs.most_urgent: Our technicians waste 3-4 hours daily driving between jobs - fuel and labor costs are crushing us
test_inputs.repetitive_tasks: Manual route planning each morning, calling customers with arrival updates, rescheduling when emergencies arise
test_inputs.task_frequency: Route planning: 1 hour daily for dispatcher. Customer update calls: 2 hours daily. Rescheduling: 45 minutes when emergencies hit
test_inputs.bottlenecks: No real-time visibility of technician locations, customers angry about vague time windows, emergency calls chaos
test_inputs.bottleneck_impact: High fuel costs, overtime pay, 1-star reviews about poor communication, lost repeat customers
test_inputs.automation_experience: Use basic CRM but dispatch is all manual phone calls and paper schedules
test_inputs.automation_results: CRM helps track customers but scheduling is still chaos - no integration

expected_ai_opportunities: Automated customer notifications with real-time updates

niche_small_business_test_cases.description: Women's clothing boutique with poor inventory management, seasonal buying mistakes, and manual sales tracking
niche_small_business_test_cases.specific_scenario: End up with 40% unsold inventory each season, manual sales tracking, no data on what sells when

test_inputs.business_priorities: Reduce end-of-season inventory, predict what will sell, automate reordering of basics
test_inputs.most_urgent: We're stuck with $8000 worth of unsold clothes from last season - can't afford another buying mistake
test_inputs.repetitive_tasks: Manual inventory counts, tracking what sizes sell out first, calculating reorder quantities for basics
test_inputs.task_frequency: Full inventory: 4 hours weekly. Sales analysis: 2 hours weekly. Reorder calculations: 1 hour weekly
test_inputs.bottlenecks: Don't know which styles will be popular, sizes sell unevenly, running out of bestsellers mid-season
test_inputs.bottleneck_impact: Clearance sales at 60% off, lost sales from stockouts, cash tied up in dead inventory
test_inputs.data_accessibility: Very difficult to access or incomplete
test_inputs.automation_experience: Use Shopify for online sales but everything else is manual
test_inputs.automation_results: Shopify tracks online sales but we have no insight into what's working in-store

expected_ai_opportunities: Automated reorder points for core items

niche_small_business_test_cases.description: Dental practice drowning in insurance verification, claim denials, and manual benefits checking
niche_small_business_test_cases.specific_scenario: 30% of claims get denied, spend 3 hours daily on insurance verification, patients surprised by out-of-pocket costs

test_inputs.business_priorities: Reduce insurance claim denials, automate benefits verification, improve patient cost estimates
test_inputs.most_urgent: Insurance claim denials are costing us $4500 monthly in rejected payments and staff time to resubmit
test_inputs.repetitive_tasks: Verifying insurance benefits before appointments, calling insurance companies for pre-approvals, resubmitting denied claims
test_inputs.task_frequency: Benefits verification: 25 patients daily at 7 minutes each = 3 hours. Claim resubmissions: 1.5 hours daily
test_inputs.bottlenecks: Insurance companies take 20+ minutes on hold, benefits change without notice, coding errors cause denials
test_inputs.bottleneck_impact: Patients angry about surprise bills, cash flow delays from claim denials, staff burnout from insurance calls
test_inputs.automation_experience: Use dental practice software but insurance verification is still manual
test_inputs.automation_results: Practice management software helps with scheduling but insurance is still a nightmare

niche_small_business_test_cases.description: Landscaping company with inefficient crew scheduling, equipment tracking issues, and manual job costing
niche_small_business_test_cases.specific_scenario: Crews sit idle waiting for equipment, manual time tracking leads to billing disputes, no visibility into job profitability

test_inputs.business_priorities: Optimize crew scheduling, track equipment location, automate job costing and billing
test_inputs.most_urgent: We're losing money on jobs but don't know which ones - manual time tracking is completely unreliable
test_inputs.repetitive_tasks: Creating daily crew schedules, tracking equipment between job sites, calculating actual job costs after completion
test_inputs.task_frequency: Crew scheduling: 2 hours daily. Equipment tracking calls: 1 hour daily. Job costing: 3 hours weekly
test_inputs.bottlenecks: Equipment goes missing between sites, crews show up without proper tools, billing disputes over hours worked
test_inputs.bottleneck_impact: Crews idle 20% of time waiting for equipment, billing disputes delay payments, no idea which jobs are profitable
test_inputs.data_accessibility: Very difficult to access or incomplete
test_inputs.automation_experience: Tried GPS tracking on trucks but crews disable it
test_inputs.automation_results: GPS tracking failed because crews saw it as micromanagement and found workarounds

expected_ai_opportunities: Real-time job costing and profitability tracking

niche_small_business_test_cases.description: Artisan bakery with high waste from overproduction, manual production planning, and no demand forecasting
niche_small_business_test_cases.specific_scenario: 25% daily waste, baking quantities based on gut feeling, running out of popular items by noon

test_inputs.business_priorities: Reduce daily waste, predict demand by item, optimize production scheduling
test_inputs.most_urgent: We throw away $200-300 worth of baked goods daily - it's heartbreaking and unsustainable
test_inputs.repetitive_tasks: Planning daily production quantities, tracking what sells out when, calculating ingredient needs
test_inputs.task_frequency: Production planning: 30 minutes daily. Sales tracking: 20 minutes. Ingredient calculations: 45 minutes
test_inputs.bottlenecks: Don't know how weather affects sales, special events cause unpredictable demand, weekend vs weekday patterns unclear
test_inputs.bottleneck_impact: High waste costs, disappointed customers when favorites sell out, inconsistent availability hurts reputation
test_inputs.data_accessibility: Very difficult to access or incomplete
test_inputs.automation_experience: Only use a basic POS system for payments
test_inputs.automation_results: POS tracks sales totals but we have no insight into item-level patterns or timing

niche_small_business_test_cases.description: Auto repair shop with parts inventory chaos, manual job estimates, and customer communication issues
niche_small_business_test_cases.specific_scenario: Parts orders delayed by manual lookup, estimates take 2 hours to create, customers complain about lack of updates

test_inputs.business_priorities: Speed up parts ordering, automate repair estimates, improve customer communication
test_inputs.most_urgent: Creating estimates takes forever and we lose customers who go elsewhere while waiting 2 days for a quote
test_inputs.repetitive_tasks: Looking up part numbers across multiple catalogs, calling suppliers for availability, manually calculating labor hours

test_inputs.bottlenecks: Parts catalogs don't match, suppliers have different part numbers, labor time estimates are inconsistent
test_inputs.bottleneck_impact: Slow estimates lose customers, wrong parts delay repairs, customers angry about lack of communication

niche_small_business_test_cases.description: Family law firm drowning in document review, manual case file organization, and billing inefficiencies
niche_small_business_test_cases.specific_scenario: Attorneys spend 40% of time on document review, case files scattered across systems, billing disputes from poor time tracking

test_inputs.business_priorities: Automate document review and organization, improve time tracking accuracy, streamline case file management
test_inputs.most_urgent: Our attorneys are spending 3-4 hours daily on document review that paralegals could handle with better tools
test_inputs.repetitive_tasks: Reviewing discovery documents for relevance, organizing case files across multiple systems, manually tracking billable time
test_inputs.task_frequency: Document review: 4 hours daily per attorney. File organization: 1 hour daily. Time entry corrections: 30 minutes daily
test_inputs.bottlenecks: Documents stored in email, shared drives, and physical files. Time tracking is inconsistent and causes billing disputes
test_inputs.bottleneck_impact: High attorney hourly costs on routine work, lost billable time from poor tracking, client disputes over bills
test_inputs.automation_experience: Use practice management software but document handling is still manual
test_inputs.automation_results: Practice software helps with scheduling but we're drowning in documents and billing issues

expected_ai_opportunities: Automated time tracking from calendar and documents

niche_small_business_test_cases.description: Commercial cleaning service with inefficient route planning, manual quality control, and supply waste
niche_small_business_test_cases.specific_scenario: Cleaners drive 2+ hours between jobs daily, no systematic quality checks, 20% supply waste from overuse

test_inputs.business_priorities: Optimize cleaning routes, implement quality control system, reduce supply waste and costs
test_inputs.most_urgent: Our cleaning teams waste 2-3 hours daily driving between jobs - fuel and labor costs are out of control
test_inputs.repetitive_tasks: Manual route planning each day, calling clients about access issues, tracking supply usage across teams
test_inputs.task_frequency: Route planning: 1.5 hours daily. Client coordination calls: 1 hour daily. Supply tracking: 2 hours weekly
test_inputs.bottlenecks: No real-time communication with cleaning teams, quality complaints after teams have left, supply costs keep rising
test_inputs.bottleneck_impact: High fuel and overtime costs, client complaints about missed spots, supply waste cutting into profits
test_inputs.automation_experience: Tried basic scheduling software but teams couldn't adapt to it
test_inputs.automation_results: Scheduling software was too complex - teams went back to paper schedules and phone calls

expected_ai_opportunities: AI route optimization with real-time adjustments
Mobile quality control checklists with photo verification
Supply usage tracking and waste reduction
Automated client communication and access coordination

testing_instructions.how_to_use: Each test case represents a real small business scenario with specific pain points and realistic metrics. Use these to test if your AI can identify the right automation opportunities and provide accurate ROI calculations.
validation_points: Does the AI identify the specific pain points mentioned?
Are the recommended tools appropriate for the business size and budget?
Do the ROI calculations align with the realistic metrics provided?
Are the implementation timelines reasonable for small businesses?
Does the roadmap address the most urgent priority first?
testing_instructions.expected_ai_behavior: The AI should recognize industry-specific challenges, recommend appropriately-sized solutions, and provide conservative ROI estimates that account for small business resource constraints.
